items.name: blueprint
items.title: Blueprint
items.description: White technical drawing on blue paper, drawn in order, revised by hand, with one part coming to life. Good for how products work, science classes, creators and fiction.

items.name: paper-popup
items.title: Pop-up book
items.description: A pop-up book as a stage: white-edged paper characters, sets rising from the page, hanging signs and typed speech bubbles. Good for kids' stories, classes and places.

items.name: kolase-arsip
items.title: Archive collage
items.description: A newsprint collage: sticker-outlined archive cutouts, bold serif headlines, one blue circle per beat and stepped motion. Good for explainers and business histories.

items.name: microscope
items.title: Microscope lens
items.description: One unbroken zoom from slide to a single cell, measurements read from the image, focus breathing at each lens. Good for biology classes, food makers and skincare.

items.name: dataviz
items.title: Data story
items.description: A chart drawn mark by mark with a red-blue pencil on cream paper, with handwritten notes. Good for business reports, classes, creators and data stories.

items.name: ink-wash
items.title: Ink wash
items.description: Ink painting on rice paper: brushstrokes become bamboo and misty hills, a scroll of steps, empty paper, one red seal. Good for craftspeople, culture and art classes.
